$comment: One description of the annotations session ops and how each transport names them (issue #982). SessionOpDescriptionDriftTests checks every transport against it; see docs/architecture/session_op_descriptions.md. Argument names are the canonical wire names (the JSON keys a stdio or MCP caller sends; the WASM bridge, npm and Python take them positionally). Numeric flag enums (scopes, kinds, regex options, depth, diff format) are typed int; string-token enums are typed enum. An argument's own default is the one DocxSessionOps (or the request record it parses into) applies on every transport; a transport that supplies its own default for an argument the facade requires lists it under defaults, a different spelling under argNames. Both are recorded divergences, not the target. An absent transport says why; an MCP route the description cannot express (a tool selected by format or mode rather than action, or an action that reshapes or drops arguments) is recorded absent and names the real route.

mcp.absent: kept as a different shape: docxodus_annotate add takes the annotation object's fields as top-level annotationId/labelId/label/color/author arguments with its own color default (#FFEB3B); recorded here until the MCP nested-object work (#1025) can describe it

reached by mode, not action: docxodus_search mode=annotation takes the id as query plus citation and maxResults, result wrapped in {matches} (docxodus_annotate find takes only the id); not one to one, so no route is recorded
